# Worldbuilding Stack Exchange

> > A Q&A community for creating imaginary worlds, covering geography, magic systems, creatures, cultures, physics, and fictional universe design.

This Stack Exchange community helps writers, game designers, and creators develop consistent, believable fictional worlds. With 39,459+ questions, it covers everything from hard science planetary physics to fantasy magic systems, drawing on popular universes like Dune, Lord of the Rings, Dungeons & Dragons, and Warhammer 40k.

## Key Topics

- worldbuilding-process
- worldbuilding-resources
- magic-system design
- geography and terrain
- science-based worldbuilding
- creature design
- culture and society
- physics and astronomy
- software recommendations
- map creation
- climate modeling
- hard science
- fantasy worldbuilding
- space and planets
- community-wiki resources

## Getting Started

- [Tour - Worldbuilding Stack Exchange](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/tour): Site introduction explaining Q&A format for worldbuilding community
- [Worldbuilding Stack Exchange](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com): Homepage for Stack Exchange worldbuilding Q&A community
- [What topics can I ask about here? - Help Center](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/help/on-topic): Defines on-topic scope: geography, culture, creatures, magic, physics
- [How do I ask a good question? - Help Center](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/help/how-to-ask): Best practices guide for asking quality worldbuilding questions
- [What types of questions should I avoid asking? - Help Center](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/help/dont-ask): Guidelines on avoiding open-ended, subjective, or off-topic questions
- [Asking - Help Center](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/help/asking): Guidelines for asking questions: topics, closure, and best practices

## Worldbuilding Resources & Guides

- [A list of worldbuilding resources](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/143606/a-list-of-worldbuilding-resources): Community wiki resource list for worldbuilding process guidance and tools
- [Creating a realistic world map - Coastlines](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/21349/creating-a-realistic-world-map-coastlines): Worldbuilding Resources guide on realistic coastline design principles
- [Creating a realistic world map - Currents, Precipitation and Climate](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/1353/creating-a-realistic-world-map-currents-precipitation-and-climate): Worldbuilding Resources guide on ocean currents and climate modeling
- [Tips and principles for creating an accurate elevation map?](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/105765/tips-and-principles-for-creating-an-accurate-elevation-map): Elevation mapping tutorial covering tectonic plates and terrain design
- [What software is available for map creation?](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/125/what-software-is-available-for-map-creation): Software recommendations for creating world, city, and building maps
- [A List of Worldbuilding Inspiration](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/257050/a-list-of-worldbuilding-inspiration): Community wiki collection of motivational quotes for worldbuilders

## Browse Questions

- [Newest Questions - Worldbuilding Stack Exchange](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions): Browse 39,459+ newest worldbuilding questions across all topics
- [How do I track details in the organization of a complex world?](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/268239/how-do-i-track-details-in-the-organization-of-a-complex-world): Q&A on organizing complex SF novel worldbuilding with software tools
- [How does one calculate the tidal heating of a satellite?](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/61059/how-does-one-calculate-the-tidal-heating-of-a-satellite): Hard science Q&A on calculating tidal heating for planetary moons
- [How to map arms of the galaxy?](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/244457/how-to-map-arms-of-the-galaxy): Q&A on galactic sector naming and 3D coordinate systems for FTL civs
- [How to make Rune-Based Magic interesting?](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/17344/how-to-make-rune-based-magic-interesting): Designing combat-viable rune-based magic system with willpower mechanics
- [How should I calibrate and estimate pyrokinesis?](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/101376/how-should-i-calibrate-and-estimate-pyrokinesis): Low-magic pyrokinesis calibration using thermodynamics and heat transfer
- [How do I populate a small, settled island for an RPG?](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/26092/how-do-i-populate-a-small-settled-island-for-an-rpg): Medieval island population distribution guidance using MDME methodology

- [Help Center - Worldbuilding Stack Exchange](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/help): Main help center index covering asking, answering, and site policies
- [Our model - Help Center](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/help/stackexchange): Stack Exchange community model, conduct guidelines, and site navigation
- [What if I need more help? - Help Center](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/help/more-help): Additional support resources including meta-discussion and contact info
- [Help Center - Contact Us](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/contact): Contact page for support, suspensions, DMCA, and account issues
- [My Account - Help Center](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/help/account): Account management help: merging, credentials, passwords, deletion

- [How do I keep my remains safe from being summoned as a skeleton?](https://worldbuilding.stackexchange.com/questions/74710/how-do-i-keep-my-remains-safe-from-being-summoned-as-a-skeleton): Necromancy worldbuilding: protecting corpses from skeleton summoning
